fixtures.evidence: Executed analytic oracle; no physics integration

fixtures.title: Sharp corner requires multiple contacts
fixtures.evidence: Executed analytic oracle; no physics integration

fixtures.title: Open mesh has no declared solid interior
fixtures.evidence: Executed analytic oracle; no physics integration
fixtures.interpretation: A single square is an open surface. Inside/outside must be replaced by an explicit surface, half-space or closed-proxy policy.

fixtures.title: Millimetre features and metre defaults
fixtures.evidence: Executed analytic oracle; no physics integration
fixtures.interpretation: Dimensionless ratios only. Rigid settings are not automatically CPU-soft-body settings; this is not a millimetre Jolt simulation.

fixtures.title: Large coordinates erase small offsets before rebasing
fixtures.evidence: Executed analytic oracle; no physics integration
fixtures.interpretation: IEEE float arithmetic only, not a Jolt double-precision build test. Rebase while host values still retain the needed precision.

fixtures.title: Visible edge reaches beyond a clear guide
fixtures.evidence: Executed analytic oracle; no physics integration
fixtures.interpretation: A clear narrow guide cannot certify the evaluated blade. Width, twist and between-sample surface regions need a declared envelope or final-surface test.
